about.headline: About me
about.introductionText: My programming journey started in childhood and was deepened through an intensive Front-End bootcamp at the Developer Akademie. The dynamic tech world constantly inspires me, and I look forward to contributing to meaningful projects.
about.locationText: Based in Siegen, NRW, I am open to remote positions but cannot relocate.
about.learningText: I am passionate about learning new technologies and continuously advancing my skills.
about.solvingText: My problem-solving style is hands-on and iterative. I work well independently but actively seek collaboration on tougher challenges, blending careful planning with actionable solutions.

skills.headline: Skills
skills.description: Through hands-on work with diverse projects, I've built strong skills in modern frontend technologies including HTML,CSS, and JavaScript. I'm always eager to learn and adapt to new tools and frameworks. For me, continuous growth is essential to stay current in the fast-evolving field of web development.
skills.followup: Enthusiastic about learning new technologies and frameworks.

portfolio.description: Explore a selection of my work — interact with the projects to see my skills in action.

elpollo.description: Jump, run and throw game based on object-oriented approach. Help Pepe to find coins and tabasco salsa to fight against the crazy chicken.

pokedex.description: Interactive Pokémon catalog fetching live data from the PokéAPI. Browse, search, and view detailed stats for hundreds of Pokémon.

videoflix.description: REST API backend for a Netflix-style streaming platform. Manages user accounts, videos, and adaptive HLS playback- all via HTTP endpoints.

quizly.description: REST API backend that turns YouTube videos into multiple-choice quizzes. Extracts audio, transcribes it via speech-to-text, and generates structured quiz questions using AI.

coderr.description: REST API backend for a freelancer platform. Providers create tiered offers, customers place orders, and completedjobs get reviewed - all via HTTP endpoints.

kanmind.description: REST API backend for a Kanban-style project management tool built with Django REST Framework, supporting boards, task management, and comments.

join.description: Task manager inspired by the Kanban system. Create and organize tasks using drag & drop, assign users and categories.

portfolioProject.description: Personal portfolio website built with Angular, featuring bilingual content, an EmailJS-powered contact form, and live project showcases.

When the website is accessed, the web server (nginx) automatically records access data (including IP address, date and time of access, page requested, browser type) in a log file. Accessing this version may involve processing of access data by GitHub (GitHub, Inc., USA) as part of standard server operation. sections.heading: Transcript of Records
paragraphs: Altin Torba successfully completed our continuing education program in Backend Development on August 19, 2026.

sections.heading: About the Developer Akademie:
paragraphs: The Developer Akademie was founded by former managers and tech employees of successful digital companies. Its goal is to offer a flexible, intensive online training program that helps career changers become software developers. The training is highly practice-oriented and takes place in direct exchange with experienced developers, with continuous feedback on projects and reviews of code and architecture against best practices at its core.

Several hundred employers in Germany, Austria and Switzerland have already hired Developer Akademie graduates. Our graduates work in IT roles at, among others, large corporations (e.g. Siemens, Allianz, Eurowings, KPMG) as well as start-ups (e.g. RobCo, sellerpoint) and web agencies (e.g. Syncpilot, Birkle IT).

sections.heading: Altin Torba was intensively trained by us in the following backend topics:
bullets: Setting up a scalable business architecture (Venv, signals, OS packages, main memory caching, Redis, task queue)
Professional deployment (Docker, CDN, Google Cloud, Heroku)
Python, Django as a framework (incl. Django REST Framework)
Operating systems and general fundamentals (Linux, terminal usage, WSL, Linux programs, package managers, honeypot)
Working with various types of databases (SQLite, PostgreSQL, Redis, Supabase)
Building REST APIs
HTTP & HTTPS (with SSL)

sections.heading: In total, backends for more than 4 complex projects were built over the past months, including:
bullets: A Kanban project management tool with a statistics dashboard (Python & Django incl. REST Framework)
A B2B freelancer marketplace for developers (Python, Django incl. REST Framework)
A high-performance video platform in the style of YouTube or Netflix (Django & Python)
An AI-powered application that automatically generates interactive quizzes from videos (Python, Django incl. REST Framework, JWT authentication, LLMs)

sections.heading: Qualities of our graduates:
paragraphs: The completed training program is demanding, time-intensive and highly practice-oriented. Successful graduates therefore demonstrate an above-average level of discipline, determination and teamwork. Thanks to months of hands-on experience, they quickly settle into value-creating roles within their teams.
The Developer Akademie team congratulates Altin Torba on his achievements and successful completion, and wishes him all the best for his future career.
